title: I got H0033 “Unable to access Sentinel HASP Run-time Environment” error.
content: The error message occurs when HASP driver is installed improperly in your PC. To check if the HASP driver is installed properly in your PC, type http://localhost:1947 or http://127.0.1:1947 in a browser and see if the following image shows up. If you can’t see the image below, it means that the HASP drive is not installed properly. To solve this problem, download HASP driver from the link below and install it. Windows: http://211.191.168.213/data/haspdinst.exe Mac: http://211.191.0.168/213/data/Sentinel_LDK_RTE_Installer.dmg
content_description: This page provides troubleshooting steps for verifying and installing the HASP driver on your PC to ensure proper functionality.

title: I got H0040 “Communication error between local and remote Sentinel HASP License Managers” error.
content: The error occurs when the Server PC and the Client PC could not communicate with each other. To solve the problem, 1. Enter “services.msc” in the execution window. 2. Check if Sentinel Local License Manager is “getting started” in the service window. If the status is not “getting started”, click your right mouse button and choose “Start” then restart your computer. 3. If you still have the problem, check if the version of the HASP driver in the Server PC and the Client PC is the same. If they are different, make their version the same. You can get the version information from the image below. 4. If any of the above methods do not work, ask a network expert for help on how to communicate the status between ports such as Server and Client 5. Check if 1947 port is occupied by other services or not.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide to troubleshoot communication errors between a Server PC and Client PC, focusing on service status, driver version compatibility, and port availability.

title: My character skinned in 3dsmax looks a bit different after exporting as an open-collada format.
content: Skinning an avatar in 3dsmax includes two categories called "Skin" and "Physics". An Open-Collada file format can only support the "Skin" way perfectly. If you face an issue importing an Open Collada file or importing an avatar including animation, please try with FBX either Alembic file format with PC2.
content_description: This webpage provides guidance on skinning avatars in 3ds Max, emphasizing the compatibility of the Open-Collada file format with "Skin" and recommending FBX or Alembic with PC2 for importing animated avatars.

title: Shirring and Crease Principle
content: ### Shirring principle In this course, we will explore the different types of shirring shapes based on fabric. In addition to the wrinkles generated by the default fabric, there are various types of wrinkles, such as narrow wrinkles and wide wrinkles. You can achieve the desired wrinkles by adjusting the Detail items in the Fabric Property, but it may be challenging for beginners. However, if you understand the differences in how each fabric forms wrinkles, you can easily create various styles of wrinkles. ### Crease principle In this course, we will learn about the shape of creases based on fabric. When fabrics are stretched or overlapped with each other, various creases are formed based on the type of fabric. Following the Shirring principle, you can refer to the creases made for each fabric and apply them to the clothes you plan to create in the future.
content_description: This webpage aims to provide a comprehensive overview of shirring and crease principles in fabric design, enabling users to understand and apply various wrinkle and crease styles to enhance their clothing creations.
